description: Hand-authored ground truth for the post-battery synthetic fixture. Mirrors the 12-item PSM battery (HTTP_CALLS via reqwest, axum builder routes, impl Trait, SAFETY rationale, fetch in TS) so future PRs can't regress these capabilities silently.
notes: Floors set to CURRENT observed capability so the gate detects regressions. Empirical state on 2026-05-08 main: HTTP_CALLS=2 (both from web/fetch.tsx fetch() calls cross-resolving to axum_routes.build_router via shared /api/users path; reqwest extractor does NOT fire on the Client::new().get(...).send() chain pattern in reqwest_calls.rs); IMPLEMENTS=2 (Cat-Animal + Dog-Animal); HANDLES=3 (the axum router's 3 .route() calls); Rationale[SAFETY]=1 (do_unsafe_thing). FUTURE GATES: when Phase C1 (Rust reqwest URL extraction) ships, raise expected_http_calls_min to 6 (the 4 reqwest calls + 2 fetch cross-links); when Phase C2 (TS/JSX fetch reclassification) ships and HandlerRef-based resolution (D1) is in place, the fetch edges will be classified consistently. The reqwest_calls.rs fixture file is intentionally retained at the current state so the C1 PR's reqwest extractor is exercised against it.
